Alex — thanks again for carving out time today. Quick recap from our 45-minute discovery: 

- Goal: prove a 30–40% token-cost reduction for RetailX's chat agent while meeting 95th-percentile latency < 250ms for customer-facing flows.
- Current blocker: procurement/architecture wants a VP/CTO level alignment to sign off on data residency and rollout gating for the initial pilot.
- Technical ask: a short deep dive (45–60m) with your infra/ML lead to validate KV-caching approach and expected latencies on your production-tail sequences.

Proposed next steps:
1) Schedule a 30-min VP/CTO intro (leadership-level) — this is the gating meeting to unblock procurement.
2) Follow with a 60-min technical deep-dive that includes your infra lead (Jaya), our runtime engineers (Rishi), and a short runbook review.

I can be flexible this week — my availability below. If you prefer, drop 2 slots and I’ll lock calendar invites and share a short mutual action plan.

Marcus’ availability (Pacific):
- Tue Oct 6: 09:00–11:00, 15:00–16:00
- Wed Oct 7: 10:00–12:00
- Thu Oct 8: 13:00–16:00

Attaching a 1-page mutual action plan (draft) and our baseline proposal for the pilot.
